starterDeckMix.note: Ken, Oct 31: the Warband (default) deck carries 30 Miners (half the deck, never under 28); Miners are at least a third of every other starter deck; the four styles are in tools/gen-starter-decks.py

combat._note: Combat v4 (Ken, Nov 7: 'only miss every once in a while ... block every once in a while ... like one out of every 5 ... if they block once, they should only block 1 per little skirmish'). Attack = swings. Each swing: a d100, missPct or less misses; a landed swing is blocked on a d100 of the defender's block chance or less: blockPct, + blockHealthStepPct per Health above 2 (at most blockHealthMaxPct), + armoredPct for Armored / Riot Shield, - largeBlockMinusPct for a Large unit (cost bigUnitCost or more), - bigAttackerMinusPct against a Large attacker, kept within blockMinPct..blockMaxPct. Commanders block on commanderBlockPct. blockOncePerSkirmish: each unit blocks at most once per fight (the attack, its strike back and any Assist). missStreakGuard: a unit never misses twice in a row in one fight. Ranged attacks and abilities use the shown Attack. dice 'sure' = tests: every swing hits, nothing blocks.
combat._pauseNote: Ken, Nov 1: milliseconds of pause before every swing (attacks, strike-backs, ranged shots, the computer's too); the hit / miss / block sound and sticker come only when the swing lands.

costFormula._note: Ken, Nov 1: cost = Attack + Health + ability bonus, halved and rounded up; above halfUpTo it climbs overPer per point from overBase; cap, min. Bonus: bigBonus for a big ability, smallBonus for any other, 0 for Miner abilities; only the biggest counts. A card's costOverride (in cards.json) wins over the formula. See src/engine/cost.ts and tools/gen-costs.py.
costFormula._zeroNote: Nov 5: tiny conditional perks (Hex Cadet, Ratchet Runt, Hammerhand Apprentice) and a token's "can't attack" cost nothing, as the approved proposal prices them.

feetByCost._note: Ken, Nov 1: feet follow the formula cost (an override never changes feet); every Miner walks 1; walls walk wallMove.

_upgradeNote: Ken, Nov 1: a creature takes at most upgradeCap Miner-card upgrades (basic or Smith); spells and auras don't count.

tokens._note: Nov 5 (Ken approved the new cards): tokens appear in play, never in a deck or pack; spawn cost and the max per player live on the token card (tokenCost, tokenMax); Sooey! Hog Call ignores the cap.
